Help equip the journey

The camera behind the reporting.

My Canon C70 has been with me for nearly five years.

It has travelled thousands of kilometres with me and filmed stories across Europe and Ukraine. It has been dropped, battered, repaired, covered in dust and dragged through conditions cameras were probably never designed for.

And it is reaching the end of its life.

Before this journey, I would love to replace it with a new main camera that can stay with me for the next five years, and buy enough high-capacity SSD storage that every frame we shoot can exist in at least two places before we leave each location.

I am keeping those purchases separate from the main trip production budget. If you would rather know exactly what your contribution bought, you can help fund a specific piece of kit here.
